name: Application Insights
summary: Workspace-based Application Insights component for application performance monitoring: request and dependency tracing, exceptions and live metrics.
useWhen: You need APM (traces, dependency calls, exceptions, live metrics) for an app, not just infrastructure logs
You want distributed tracing across services
avoidWhen: You only need platform diagnostic logs and metrics (use diagnostics settings to the Log Analytics workspace directly, no Application Insights needed)
